binding.callbackUnavailable: Plugin callbacks are disabled. Channels that receive messages through callbacks are unavailable
binding.callbackReused: The existing callback URL is reused. No change is needed in the platform settings. Rotate it on the plugin page to get a new URL
binding.callbackAbsolute: Paste this URL into the platform’s callback or message receiver settings. The full URL is shown only during this linking request
binding.callbackRelative: No external address is configured. Set it in Settings → App settings, then add it before this path
binding.expired: The pairing code has expired. Start linking again
binding.closed: The channel plugin has been disabled
binding.missingResult: The linking result is missing. Start again
binding.pairing: Send pairing code {code} to @{name} in a private chat on {channel}
binding.callbackPairing: First set the callback URL in {channel}, then send pairing code {code} to “{name}” on {channel}
binding.tooManyAttempts: Too many incorrect pairing codes. This request is invalid. Start linking again
binding.lost: The linking state was lost. Start again
binding.testMessage: 📣 This is a test push from MovieClaw. If you received it, the channel is working!
binding.missing: This linking request does not exist or has expired

pairing.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong pairing codes, so this binding was cancelled. Start a new binding from Settings.
pairing.wrongCode: That pairing code is wrong. Send the 6-digit code shown in Settings to finish binding.
pairing.success: Binding complete! I’m the MovieClaw assistant; send me a message whenever you need something.
